remarks: WHAT A DEAL! EVERYTHING'S INCLUDED IN THIS BRAND-NEW HOME: CENTRAL A/C, DECK, ALL APPLIANCES, AND BLINDS. MOVE-IN READY WITH A FULLY FINISHED LEGAL BASEMENT SUITE! Built by Rohit Homes, this popular Talo model offers stress-free, low-maintenance bare-land condo living with great mortgage-helper potential, close to Windermere, and just off Rabbit Hill Road. The bright, open-concept main floor flows easily from the living room to a large dining area, with a powder room and a functional kitchen that walks right out to the rear deck. Upstairs you'll find 3 spacious bedrooms & 2 full bathrooms, including a primary retreat with its own ensuite, plus a handy office nook and upstairs laundry. A separate side entrance leads to the fully finished basement suite, complete with its own kitchen, living room, bedroom, full bathroom, second laundry room, & second furnace. Turnkey value from top to bottom — perfect for an investor or anyone who wants a low-maintenance home with a rental suite to help with the mortgage. (id:67522)
